name: Chicken chow mein
steps: Boil the egg noodles until just tender, then drain and toss with a little oil.
Slice the chicken breast thinly and stir-fry in hot oil until cooked through.
Add the shredded cabbage and carrot and stir-fry until softened.
Return the noodles to the pan and pour over the soy sauce.
Toss everything over high heat until glossy and hot through.
